_comment: The two artifacts this one repo produces, and the single source of truth for
what may enter each. bin/build-zip.sh stages from here, bin/check-artifacts.mjs
enforces the rules below, and CI runs that checker on every pull request.
ARCH-1 puts a Blueworx Forge plugin on the client's own WordPress. The point of
two artifacts rather than one plugin with a switch is that a client's site
cannot physically contain command-centre code — not that it is configured not
That guarantee is enforced by geography: everything the client artifact ships
lives under client/, and studio code lives everywhere else. A path is either
inside client/ or it cannot be in the client allowlist. 'shared' is the one
exception and is itself a closed list in the checker — client sites need the
update checker, or they could never receive a fix.
